data_fields.name: pause_max_humans
data_fields.donor_constant: pause only when 1 connected human (count > 1 means no pause)

best_idea: Bank elapsed time in a residual, run whole fixed steps while it covers one, clamp a single pass to a configured hitch limit, and do not bank time while paused.
decision_why: Take the residual loop with a hitch clamp for the server tick (row 18), but set the clamp as a small data field decided by Lead instead of the donor's 5000 ms, and adopt the no-bank rule for any server pause; simulated-time timeouts need a separate ruling.
acceptance: Server test: a 3 s hitch passed into one pass runs no more than the configured step cap, and a pass with the pause flag set runs zero steps and leaves the residual unchanged.
